settings.heading: Two Decades of Curation
settings.body:
For over two decades, MARAIS has stood as a cornerstone of the Australian luxury landscape. Established in Melbourne, our journey began with a vision to bring the world's most prestigious fashion houses to local shores — fostering a sophisticated dialogue between global trends and the Australian lifestyle.

What began as a single boutique has grown into a multi-destination experience. With several flagship locations across Melbourne and the 2021 launch of our global digital platform, MARAIS continues to define the height of high-end retail.

settings.title: Ready-to-Wear
settings.body: From iconic heritage houses to the avant-garde new guard — every season's most considered pieces, chosen without compromise.

settings.title: Accessories
settings.body: An expansive selection of footwear, bags, and leather goods from the houses that define the form.

settings.title: Lifestyle & Jewellery
settings.body: A sophisticated range of fine jewellery and curated lifestyle products — chosen for artistry and enduring appeal.

settings.title: A Living Edit
settings.intro: Our edit is a living, breathing collection. Whether a debut from an emerging designer or a limited-run piece from an established icon, every item is chosen for its artistry and enduring appeal.

settings.headline: The Multi-Brand Debut
settings.body: MARAIS makes its landmark debut at Melbourne's historic Royal Arcade, introducing a sophisticated curation of international heavyweights including Balenciaga, Lanvin, Givenchy, Mastermind, and Rick Owens.

settings.headline: Mastermind Japan Anniversary
settings.body: A prestigious honorary event is hosted by MARAIS Multi, featuring an exclusive appearance by Mastermind Japan founder, Masaaki Homma.

settings.headline: A New Identity
settings.body: The original multi-brand concept undergoes a strategic transformation into MARAIS Men.

settings.headline: The Women's Flagship
settings.body: Elevating the Melbourne retail landscape, the MARAIS Women flagship opens its doors on Bourke Street.

settings.headline: Sydney Launch
settings.body: MARAIS facilitates the launch of Australia's first Givenchy Boutique at Westfield Sydney.

settings.headline: Queensland Arrival
settings.body: Expansion continues with the opening of Givenchy Pacific Fair on the Gold Coast.

settings.headline: Givenchy Chadstone
settings.body: Givenchy Chadstone officially opens at the Fashion Capital, Chadstone Shopping Centre.

settings.headline: Department Store Presence
settings.body: The Givenchy partnership expands into luxury retail with a concession at David Jones, Sydney.

settings.headline: A World First for Chanel
settings.body: MARAIS Women makes fashion history by hosting the world's only all-categories Chanel Pop-Up for the Métiers d'Art Pre-Fall 2017 collection.

settings.headline: The Off-White Era
settings.body: MARAIS brings Virgil Abloh's vision to Australia, launching the first Off-White store at QV Melbourne, followed by a second at Westfield Sydney.

settings.headline: Loewe Paula's Ibiza
settings.body: LOEWE debuted its highly anticipated Paula's Ibiza collection in Australia with an exclusive pop-up at MARAIS in the heart of Melbourne.

settings.headline: Digital Evolution
settings.body: The brand goes global with the official launch of MARAIS Online.

settings.headline: Men's Flagship Relocation
settings.body: A new era for menswear begins with the opening of the MARAIS Men flagship at QV Melbourne.

settings.headline: Chadstone Menswear
settings.body: The MARAIS Men footprint expands to Chadstone Shopping Centre.

settings.headline: The Expansion Milestone
settings.body: A banner year for the brand, marked by the dual openings of MARAIS Women at both Chadstone and QV Melbourne.
